scoring_notes: Quality and Durability dominate because countertops are material-driven: composition, manufacturing consistency, and resistance profiles determine the score. Performance at 0.20 covers functional specs (heat resistance, stain resistance, scratch hardness) but these are inherent to the material, not engineered features.

calibration_products.name: Cambria (US Engineered Quartz)
calibration_products.rationale: Family-owned (Davis family), single US factory Le Sueur MN. 93% quartz content. Highest manufacturing consistency — no multi-source variance. GREENGUARD Gold certified. Chipping class-action was pre-2020 formula. Fabricator consensus: best engineered quartz for consistency and quality. NSF 51 food contact certified.

calibration_products.name: Dekton (Cosentino Ultra-Compact)
calibration_products.rationale: Sintered stone — glass, porcelain, quartz at 25,000°C+ and extreme pressure. Near-zero porosity. Top heat resistance (500°F+), UV stable, scratch resistant. No resins = no off-gassing. Lifetime residential warranty. Field cracking reports near cooktops need further investigation. Cosentino (Spain) — global manufacturer.

calibration_products.name: Caesarstone (Global Engineered Quartz)
calibration_products.rationale: Israeli/global manufacturer. 93% quartz, 7% resin. Breton technology. Multiple plant locations (Israel, Georgia USA, India, China) — quality consistency across plants is the concern. GREENGUARD Gold. Strong brand but multi-source manufacturing introduces variance risk that Cambria avoids.

calibration_products.name: Silestone (Cosentino Engineered Quartz)
calibration_products.rationale: Cosentino's engineered quartz line. Anti-bacterial marketing settlement (no durability impact). HybriQ+ technology (recycled materials). Strong brand, good distribution. Slightly below Caesarstone in fabricator consensus. N-Boost technology claimed but independent verification sparse.

calibration_products.name: Corian (Solid Surface)
calibration_products.rationale: PMMA acrylic resin-based solid surface. Seamless, repairable, thermoformable — genuine functional advantages. BUT: heat vulnerable (damage begins ~200°F), scratches easily, requires periodic sanding. CorStar Capital ownership (post-DuPont). Fabricators moved on from Corian for high-end but it has a legitimate repairability niche.

calibration_products.name: MSI Q Quartz (Import)
calibration_products.rationale: MSI is a distribution/import company, not a manufacturer. Slabs sourced from multiple factories (India, China, Turkey, Brazil) under one brand. Documented lot-to-lot inconsistency. Known voids, cracking reports. Fabricators warn about quality variance. Big-box and budget fabricator staple. No single-source quality control.
